title: Average height of South Korean women, by birth year (cm)

source.name: A century of trends in adult human height
source.publisher: NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (NCD-RisC), published in eLife

notes: Illustrative interpolation between the study's headline endpoints: women born in South Korea in 1896 averaged approximately 142.2cm; those born in 1996 averaged approximately 162.3cm, a 20.2cm gain, the single largest national increase of the 200 countries studied. Intermediate points are approximate.
